name: Securities Financing Transaction Details 59
definition: Details of the closing of the securities financing transaction.

SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.name: Securities Financing Trade Identification
SecuritiesFinancingTradeIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the underlying securities financing trade as assigned by the instructing party. The identification is common to all collateral pieces (one or many).

SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.name: Securities Financing Unique Transaction Identifier
SecuritiesFinancingUniqueTransactionIden.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

ClosingLegIdentification.name: Closing Leg Identification
ClosingLegIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the second leg of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party acting on its behalf).

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Identification assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.definition: Unique identification identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the triparty-agent's/service-provider's point of view.

ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.name: Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the client's point of view.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Market in which a trade transaction has been executed.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

SettlementQuantity.name: Settlement Quantity
SettlementQuantity.definition: Total quantity of securities to be settled.

OpeningSettlementAmount.name: Opening Settlement Amount
OpeningSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be paid or received in exchange for the securities at the opening of a securities financing transaction.

TerminationTransactionAmount.name: Termination Transaction Amount
TerminationTransactionAmount.definition: Total amount of money to be settled to terminate the transaction.

DigitalPaymentSettlement.name: Digital Payment Settlement
DigitalPaymentSettlement.definition: Amount of digital asset that is to be/was posted to the account as a means of payment.

OpeningSettlementDate.name: Opening Settlement Date
OpeningSettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

TerminationDate.name: Termination Date
TerminationDate.definition: Closing date/time or maturity date/time of the transaction.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Specifies the date/time on which the trade was executed.

ExpectedSettlementDate.name: Expected Settlement Date
ExpectedSettlementDate.definition: Date/time at which the sender expects settlement.

ExpectedValueDate.name: Expected Value Date
ExpectedValueDate.definition: For against payment transactions, the value date/time at which the account servicer expects the settlement amount to be credited or debited.

LateDeliveryDate.name: Late Delivery Date
LateDeliveryDate.definition: Date and time after the settlement date specified in the trade, used for pool trades resulting from the original To Be Assigned (TBA) securities.

RateChangeDate.name: Rate Change Date
RateChangeDate.definition: Date/Time at which rate change has taken place.

SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType.name: Securities Financing Transaction Type
SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType.definition: Specifies the type of securities financing transaction, that is, repurchase agreement, reverse repurchase agreement, securities lending or securities borrowing.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies if the movement on a securities account results from a deliver or a receive instruction.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies how the transaction is to be settled, for example, against payment.

SettlementParameters.name: Settlement Parameters
SettlementParameters.definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

RateType.name: Rate Type
RateType.definition: Specifies whether the rate is fixed or variable.

VariableRateSupport.name: Variable Rate Support
VariableRateSupport.definition: Index or support rate used together with the spread to calculate the repurchase rate.

RepurchaseRate.name: Repurchase Rate
RepurchaseRate.definition: Rate to be used to recalculate the repurchase amount.

StockLoanMargin.name: Stock Loan Margin
StockLoanMargin.definition: Percentage mark-up on a loan consideration used to reflect the lender's risk.

SecuritiesHaircut.name: Securities Haircut
SecuritiesHaircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

PricingRate.name: Pricing Rate
PricingRate.definition: Interest rate to be paid on the transaction amount, as agreed between the counterparties.

Spread.name: Spread
Spread.definition: Repurchase spread expressed as a rate; margin over or under an index that determines the repurchase rate.

DeliveringSettlementParties.name: Delivering Settlement Parties
DeliveringSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of delivering settlement parties.

ReceivingSettlementParties.name: Receiving Settlement Parties
ReceivingSettlementParties.definition: Identifies the chain of receiving settlement parties.

Investor.name: Investor
Investor.definition: Party, either an individual or organisation, whose assets are being invested.

SettlementInstructionProcessingAdditiona.name: Settlement Instruction Processing Additional Details
SettlementInstructionProcessingAdditiona.definition: Provides additional settlement processing information which can not be included within the structured fields of the message.

TwoLegTransactionOpeningClosingRule.definition: For transactions settling in two legs (Securities Financing), the opening/initiation and closing/return information of the transaction is provided by sending the following combination of SecuritiesMovementType codes and SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType codes:||Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: Repo (REPU)|Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: Repo (REPU)||Reverse Repo Opening|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)|Reverse Repo Closing|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: ReverseRepo (RVPO)||Securities Lending Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)|Securities Lending Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: SecuritiesLending (SECL)||Securities Borrowing Initiation|SecuritiesMovementType: Receive (RECE)|SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB)|Securities Borrowing Return|SecuritiesMovementType: Delivery (DELI) |SecuritiesFinancingTransactionType: SecuritiesBorrowing (SECB).

AdditionalDetailsRule.definition: Unless bilaterally agreed between the sender and receiver, if SettlementInstructionProcessingAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
